mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_payment_intent WHERE source_type = 'SALES_ORDER' AND source_id = #{orderId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_finance_receivable WHERE order_id = #{orderId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_inventory_reservation WHERE source_document_type = 'SALES_ORDER_ITEM' AND source_document_id = #{orderId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_inventory_outbound_item WHERE sales_order_id = #{orderId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_sorting_task_item WHERE sales_order_id = #{orderId})
SELECT count(*) FROM xsy_sales_order WHERE customer_id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM xsy_sales_order WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT o.* FROM xsy_sales_order o LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r.fulfillment_status FROM xsy_delivery_route_order r WHERE r.order_id = o.id AND r.deleted = FALSE AND r.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1) f ON TRUE WHERE o.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.order_source = 'MALL' AND o.deleted = FALSE AND o.status IN( 'DRAFT', 'PENDING')
AND o.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND COALESCE(f.fulfillment_status, 'PENDING') NOT IN ('IN_TRANSIT', 'SIGNED', 'EXCEPTION')
AND o.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND f.fulfillment_status = 'IN_TRANSIT'
AND o.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND f.fulfillment_status IN ('SIGNED', 'EXCEPTION')
AND o.status = 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC
